title: Design System: EZ Garage Doors — ORANGE STANDARD (A1-style canon in EZ orange)
northStar: The category-standard national garage-door brand site, rebuilt for one Massachusetts company: white ground, ink Barlow headings, orange as the single action color, soft cards, breadcrumbs and a sticky sidebar on every inner page. Conventional on purpose — the owner chose recognizability and trust over a signature world.

sourceOfTruth.contract: BaseLayout.astro <body> HTML comment (canon path, owner decision 2026-09-17)

world.form: A1-style national-brand structure in EZ orange (canon path; A1 Garage Door Service = craft bar, none of its assets/copy used)
predecessors: Orange Editorial Utility (retired 2026-08-19; rollback tag v2026.07-orange-editorial)

color.law: Orange is the single action color. Brand orange on white = 3.05:1 → large text only (buttons pinned at 1.175rem/700, hero headings). Small orange type uses orange-text (6.6:1). Never orange on the alt ground (2.77:1). Never orange-on-orange: on orange bands small text is ink and buttons flip to white/ink.

typography.display: Barlow Condensed 700, title case, letter-spacing 0.005em, line-height 1.08
typography.buttons: Barlow 700 1.175rem (18.8px) — the large-text threshold for white-on-orange

layout.header: ink utility strip → sticky white header: color logo, dropdown nav (CSS hover/focus-within), outline Request + orange Call; ≤66rem a <details> menu with grouped disclosures
layout.innerPage: breadcrumbs → light hero (copy | rounded photo card) → 4-stat proof strip → .page-grid (content | sticky 20rem sidebar) → related links → CTA band → footer with 14-county index

depth.rule: no other shadows; borders are 1px line

motion.reducedMotion: all transitions and animations off globally

families.service areas: 1 hub + 14 counties + 351 towns ([slug].astro from ma-towns.ts + ma-counties.ts)

contentArchitecture.antiDoorway: town pages are built from real public data (population, land area, density, incorporation, county seat, nearest towns by distance) plus hand-written county context — no town×service matrix, no invented job history

voice.readingLevel: grade 5-7 on repair pages; plain-language guides
voice.policyLine: Written Quote Before Work Begins — at every decision point
voice.coverage: Serving all 351 cities and towns across Massachusetts (owner decision); base location never published

imagery.proofModules: provenance "real" only, person-free (van-front, hardware, finished doors, before/after) — WorkGallery, BeforeAfterGallery and FinishedDoorGallery throw at build time on anything else; the reviews page carries no photography
imagery.illustrative: ai-model technician shots only as page heroes, never captioned as the actual team; stock photos (places, house styles, winter, commercial doors) only as illustration — alt text describes the scene, never the company, never claims a photo is a specific town; stock door photos near EZ's work are captioned as illustrative
imagery.uniqueness: one unique primary visual per page; the 351 town pages inherit their county's banner (no per-town photos exist or are implied)
imagery.placement: ServiceHero / .hero-split photo card for heroes; AreaHero full-bleed photo hero with location chip on county/town pages; ServicePhotoGrid illustrative photo cards; SectionImage (banner 16:6, figure 16:9) everywhere else; no brand logo over a photo
imagery.delivery: astro:assets responsive widths (hero 640/960/1280/1600, banner 720/1200/1600, figure 480/880/1320), explicit dimensions, lazy below the fold, LCP image eager + fetchpriority high

typographyRamp: see DESIGN.md frontmatter (h1, home-h1, home-h1-mobile, hero-h1, hero-h1-mobile, inner-h1, inner-h1-mobile, area-h1, guide-h1, h2, h3, body, eyebrow, caption, button, button-lg, ui-nav, stat); tokens --text-2xs 0.78rem, xs 0.8125rem, sm 0.9375rem, base 1.0625rem, lg 1.1875rem, xl/2xl/3xl/hero/mega fluid
